#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Animated title cards. Same words, with a live floor playing on the right."""
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageFont

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / "out"
AVENIR = "/System/Library/Fonts/Avenir Next.ttc"
W, H = 1920, 1080
FPS = 24

HEAVY = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 84, index=8)
DEMI = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 36, index=2)
MEDIUM = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 26, index=5)
SMALL = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 20, index=5)
PILL = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 28, index=2)
TINY = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 18, index=5)

INK = (244, 255, 248, 255)
MINT = (111, 214, 168, 255)
MUTED = (176, 206, 192, 255)
DIM = (90, 122, 110, 255)
CORAL = (224, 138, 114, 255)
PANEL = (10, 24, 20, 255)
LINE = (46, 78, 66, 255)

DURATIONS = {
    "joke-a": 6,
    "joke-b": 6,
    "joke-c": 6,
    "problem-a": 8,
    "problem-b": 14,
    "close-a": 10,
    "close-b": 10,
    "close-c": 10,
}

CARDS = {
    "joke-a": {
        "kicker": "A NEW RULE",
        "title": "There is a new\nrule going around.",
        "detail": "People are done saying AI.",
    },
    "joke-b": {
        "kicker": "THE RENAME",
        "title": "AI is over.",
        "detail": "From here on, call it SI.",
    },
    "joke-c": {
        "kicker": "SUPERINTELLIGENCE",
        "title": "Obviously.",
        "detail": "The model did not get smarter.\nThe name did.",
    },
    "problem-a": {
        "kicker": "THE PROBLEM",
        "title": "The name changed.",
        "detail": "The room did not.\nThe agents are still scattered.",
    },
    "problem-b": {
        "kicker": "FOUR FOLDERS",
        "title": "Nobody can see\nwho failed.",
        "detail": "Four agents. No shared view.\nA new name does not fix that.",
    },
    "close-a": {
        "kicker": "TRACEOFFICE",
        "title": "Every agent\ngets a seat.",
        "detail": "The floor is the project.\nThe sign is the platform.",
    },
    "close-b": {
        "kicker": "NEATLOGS",
        "title": "The trace.\nThe alert.\nThe score.",
        "detail": "The room shows who is seated.\nThe record shows what they did.",
    },
    "close-c": {
        "kicker": "THE POINT",
        "title": "SI shows up sooner\nwhen the work is watched.",
        "detail": "A seat. A trace. An alert. And a score.",
    },
}


def lerp(a, b, t):
    return tuple(int(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


def clamp(v, lo=0.0, hi=1.0):
    return lo if v < lo else hi if v > hi else v


def ease(t):
    t = clamp(t)
    return 1 - (1 - t) ** 3


def enter(t, start, dur):
    return ease((t - start) / dur)


def backdrop():
    column = Image.new("RGB", (1, H))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(column)
    top, bottom = (8, 16, 14), (18, 36, 30)
    for y in range(H):
        draw.point((0, y), fill=lerp(top, bottom, y / (H - 1)))
    image = column.resize((W, H)).convert("RGBA")
    glow = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(glow).ellipse((420, 40, 1500, 1040), fill=140)
    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(100))
    tint = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (28, 92, 72, 255))
    image.alpha_composite(Image.composite(tint, image, glow))
    return image


def tracked(draw, text, xy, font, fill, gap):
    x, y = xy
    for char in text:
        draw.text((x, y), char, font=font, fill=fill)
        x += draw.textlength(char, font=font) + gap
    return x


def blank():
    return Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))


def header_layer():
    layer = blank()
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    draw.rounded_rectangle((48, 48, W - 48, H - 48), radius=28, outline=LINE, width=2)
    draw.ellipse((96, 96, 112, 112), fill=MINT)
    tracked(draw, "TRACE OFFICE", (128, 90), SMALL, MINT, 3)
    mark = "NEATHACK"
    mark_w = sum(draw.textlength(c, font=SMALL) + 3 for c in mark)
    tracked(draw, mark, (W - 128 - mark_w, 90), SMALL, DIM, 3)
    return layer


def text_block(card):
    layer = blank()
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    y = 280
    tracked(draw, card["kicker"], (128, y), MEDIUM, MINT, 4)
    bar = (128, y + 46, 228, y + 52)
    y = 390
    title_bottom = y
    for line in card["title"].split("\n"):
        draw.text((120, y), line, font=HEAVY, fill=INK)
        title_bottom = y + 96
        y += 100
    detail_top = title_bottom + 18
    for i, line in enumerate(card["detail"].split("\n")):
        draw.text((128, detail_top + i * 48), line, font=DEMI, fill=MUTED)
    return layer, bar, detail_top


def crop_alpha(layer, p, dy=0):
    if p <= 0.01:
        return None
    bbox = layer.getbbox()
    if not bbox:
        return None
    crop = layer.crop(bbox)
    if p < 0.995:
        alpha = crop.getchannel("A").point(lambda v, p=p: int(v * p))
        crop.putalpha(alpha)
    sheet = blank()
    sheet.paste(crop, (bbox[0], bbox[1] + int(dy)), crop)
    return sheet


def pill(draw, box, text, fill, ink):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=18, fill=fill)
    tw = draw.textlength(text, font=PILL)
    draw.text((box[0] + (box[2] - box[0] - tw) / 2, box[1] + 10), text, font=PILL, fill=ink)


def row(draw, x, y, w, label, state, p):
    draw.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, y + 52), radius=12, fill=(16, 36, 30, 255))
    draw.text((x + 18, y + 12), label, font=PILL, fill=INK if p > 0.2 else DIM)
    if state and p > 0:
        sw = draw.textlength(state, font=TINY)
        color = CORAL if state == "FAILED" else MINT
        draw.text((x + w - sw - 18, y + 16), state, font=TINY, fill=(*color[:3], int(255 * p)))


def live_head(draw, x, y, t):
    pulse = 0.55 + 0.45 * abs((t * 1.6) % 2 - 1)
    r = 6
    draw.ellipse((x, y, x + r * 2, y + r * 2), fill=(*MINT[:3], int(255 * pulse)))
    tracked(draw, "LIVE", (x + 22, y - 4), TINY, MINT, 2)


def draw_stage(image, name, t, dur):
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
    x, y, w = 1288, 250, 500
    draw.rounded_rectangle((x, y, x + w, 930), radius=24, fill=PANEL, outline=LINE, width=2)
    live_head(draw, x + 28, y + 28, t)

    if name == "joke-a":
        tracked(draw, "THE RULE", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        pill(draw, (x + 28, y + 130, x + 220, y + 190), "AI", (24, 48, 40, 255), MUTED)
        strike = enter(t, 2.1, 0.45)
        if strike:
            draw.line((x + 48, y + 160, x + 48 + 150 * strike, y + 160), fill=CORAL, width=4)
        if enter(t, 2.8, 0.4):
            pill(draw, (x + 28, y + 220, x + 220, y + 280), "SI", MINT, (10, 28, 22, 255))
    elif name == "joke-b":
        tracked(draw, "RENAME", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        old = 1 - enter(t, 1.8, 0.5)
        if old > 0.05:
            draw.text((x + 36, y + 160), "AI", font=HEAVY, fill=(*DIM[:3], int(255 * old)))
        neu = enter(t, 2.5, 0.45)
        if neu:
            draw.text((x + 36, y + 300), "SI", font=HEAVY, fill=(*MINT[:3], int(255 * neu)))
    elif name == "joke-c":
        tracked(draw, "WHAT CHANGED", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        row(draw, x + 28, y + 140, w - 56, "Model", "SAME", enter(t, 1.3, 0.4))
        row(draw, x + 28, y + 214, w - 56, "Name", "SI", enter(t, 2.3, 0.4))
    elif name == "problem-a":
        tracked(draw, "STILL SCATTERED", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        spots = (("Cursor", 40, 150), ("Claude", 230, 210), ("Codex", 70, 310), ("Grok", 250, 390))
        for i, (label, dx, dy) in enumerate(spots):
            p = enter(t, 1.1 + i * 0.28, 0.35)
            if not p:
                continue
            draw.rounded_rectangle(
                (x + dx, y + dy, x + dx + 180, y + dy + 48),
                radius=14,
                fill=(16, 36, 30, int(255 * p)),
            )
            draw.text((x + dx + 16, y + dy + 8), label, font=PILL, fill=(*INK[:3], int(255 * p)))
        draw.rounded_rectangle((x + 36, y + 560, x + w - 36, y + 572), radius=4, fill=LINE)
        draw.text((x + 36, y + 590), "No floor yet", font=TINY, fill=DIM)
    elif name == "problem-b":
        tracked(draw, "FOUR FOLDERS", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        rows = ("Cursor", "Claude", "Codex", "Grok")
        for i, label in enumerate(rows):
            state = "FAILED" if i == 0 else "HIDDEN"
            row(draw, x + 28, y + 130 + i * 72, w - 56, label, state, enter(t, 1.2 + i * 0.35, 0.3))
            if i == 0:
                stamp = enter(t, 4.2, 0.35)
                if stamp:
                    draw.rounded_rectangle(
                        (x + 300, y + 140, x + 300 + 150 * stamp, y + 182),
                        radius=8,
                        outline=CORAL,
                        width=2,
                    )
    elif name == "close-a":
        tracked(draw, "THE FLOOR", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        for i, width in enumerate((420, 360, 300)):
            p = enter(t, 1.15 + i * 0.35, 0.4)
            if not p:
                continue
            yy = y + 160 + i * 78
            draw.rounded_rectangle((x + 28, yy, x + 28 + width * p, yy + 18), radius=6, fill=MINT if i == 0 else (46, 140, 112, 255))
        seats = ((0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (2, 0))
        for n, (floor, slot) in enumerate(seats):
            p = enter(t, 2.8 + n * 0.45, 0.3)
            if not p:
                continue
            cx = x + 70 + slot * 70
            cy = y + 148 + floor * 78
            draw.ellipse((cx, cy, cx + 22, cy + 22), fill=(*INK[:3], int(255 * p)))
    elif name == "close-b":
        tracked(draw, "THE RECORD", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        for i, (label, when) in enumerate((("Trace", 1.3), ("Alert", 3.1), ("Score", 5.0))):
            p = enter(t, when, 0.45)
            yy = y + 150 + i * 120
            draw.rounded_rectangle((x + 28, yy, x + w - 28, yy + 78), radius=16, fill=(16, 36, 30, 255))
            if p:
                draw.rounded_rectangle((x + 28, yy, x + 28 + (w - 56) * p, yy + 78), radius=16, fill=(*MINT[:3], 40))
            draw.text((x + 52, yy + 18), label, font=PILL, fill=INK if p > 0.85 else DIM)
    else:
        tracked(draw, "WATCHED", (x + 28, y + 70), TINY, DIM, 2)
        chips = (("Seat", 0), ("Trace", 1), ("Alert", 2), ("Score", 3))
        for i, (label, _) in enumerate(chips):
            p = enter(t, 1.2 + i * 0.7, 0.35)
            col, row_i = i % 2, i // 2
            box = (x + 28 + col * 230, y + 160 + row_i * 140, x + 230 + col * 230, y + 250 + row_i * 140)
            fill = MINT if p > 0.9 else (16, 36, 30, 255)
            ink = (10, 28, 22, 255) if p > 0.9 else DIM
            draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=18, fill=fill)
            tw = draw.textlength(label, font=PILL)
            draw.text((box[0] + (box[2] - box[0] - tw) / 2, box[1] + 28), label, font=PILL, fill=(*ink[:3], int(80 + 175 * p)))


def build_layers():
    bg = backdrop()
    head = header_layer()
    layers = {}
    for name, card in CARDS.items():
        block, bar, detail_top = text_block(card)
        layers[name] = (block, bar, detail_top)
    return bg, head, layers


def frame_at(bg, head, block, bar, detail_top, name, t, dur):
    image = bg.copy()
    head_p = enter(t, 0.05, 0.3)
    piece = crop_alpha(head, head_p)
    if piece:
        image.alpha_composite(piece)

    # Split the text block into timed bands by masking vertical slices.
    kicker = block.crop((0, 260, 1200, 360))
    title = block.crop((0, 360, 1260, detail_top - 8))
    detail = block.crop((0, detail_top - 8, 1260, detail_top + 160))
    for layer, top, start, dy in (
        (kicker, 260, 0.2, 18),
        (title, 360, 0.45, 28),
        (detail, detail_top - 8, 0.95, 16),
    ):
        p = enter(t, start, 0.4)
        if p <= 0.01:
            continue
        sheet = blank()
        crop = layer
        if p < 0.995:
            crop = layer.copy()
            crop.putalpha(crop.getchannel("A").point(lambda v, p=p: int(v * p)))
        sheet.paste(crop, (0, top + int((1 - p) * dy)), crop)
        image.alpha_composite(sheet)

    bar_p = enter(t, 0.55, 0.35)
    if bar_p:
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
        x0, y0, x1, y1 = bar
        draw.rounded_rectangle((x0, y0, x0 + (x1 - x0) * bar_p, y1), radius=3, fill=MINT)

    draw_stage(image, name, t, dur)
    return image.convert("RGB")


def still(name, second, bg, head, layers):
    block, bar, detail_top = layers[name]
    image = frame_at(bg, head, block, bar, detail_top, name, second, DURATIONS[name])
    path = OUT / f"{name}-motion.png"
    image.save(path)
    print(path)


def encode(name, bg, head, layers):
    dur = DURATIONS[name]
    block, bar, detail_top = layers[name]
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        [
            "ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-s", f"{W}x{H}",
            "-r", str(FPS), "-i", "-", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo",
            "-t", str(dur), "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-r", "30",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-shortest", str(OUT / f"{name}.mp4"), "-loglevel", "error",
        ],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    frames = int(dur * FPS)
    for i in range(frames):
        image = frame_at(bg, head, block, bar, detail_top, name, i / FPS, dur)
        proc.stdin.write(image.tobytes())
    proc.stdin.close()
    if proc.wait() != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"ffmpeg failed on {name}")
    print(name, dur)


def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    bg, head, layers = build_layers()
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--stills":
        for name in CARDS:
            still(name, 3.2, bg, head, layers)
        return
    for name in CARDS:
        encode(name, bg, head, layers)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

AVENIR = "/System/Library/Fonts/Avenir Next.ttc"
W, H = 1920, 1080
FPS = 24

PRICE = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 120, index=8)
DEMI = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 34, index=2)
MEDIUM = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 26, index=5)
SMALL = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 20, index=5)
TINY = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 18, index=5)

INK = (244, 255, 248, 255)
MINT = (111, 214, 168, 255)
MUTED = (176, 206, 192, 255)
DIM = (90, 122, 110, 255)
LINE = (46, 78, 66, 255)
PANEL = (10, 24, 20, 255)
PURPLE = (163, 101, 237, 255)
PURPLE_DEEP = (92, 48, 158, 255)
INK_BODY = (21, 21, 36, 255)

    ("pay-a", 3.6),
    ("jev", 11.4),
    ("pay-b", 18.0),
    ("pay-c", 18.821),
)


def lerp(a, b, t):
    return tuple(int(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


def clamp(v):
    return 0.0 if v < 0 else 1.0 if v > 1 else v


def ease(t):
    t = clamp(t)
    return 1 - (1 - t) ** 3


def enter(t, start, dur):
    return ease((t - start) / dur)


def backdrop():
    column = Image.new("RGB", (1, H))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(column)
    top, bottom = (8, 16, 14), (18, 36, 30)
    for y in range(H):

def cubic(p0, p1, p2, p3, n=14):

        u = 1 - t
        pts.append((
            u**3 * p0[0] + 3 * u * u * t * p1[0] + 3 * u * t * t * p2[0] + t**3 * p3[0],
            u**3 * p0[1] + 3 * u * u * t * p1[1] + 3 * u * t * t * p2[1] + t**3 * p3[1],
        ))
    return pts


def quad(p0, p1, p2, n=8):
    pts = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        t = i / n
        u = 1 - t
        pts.append((
            u * u * p0[0] + 2 * u * t * p1[0] + t * t * p2[0],
            u * u * p0[1] + 2 * u * t * p1[1] + t * t * p2[1],
        ))

        self.ground = ground
        self.scale = scale

    def P(self, x, y):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Opening card. The crew, and the name. Two seconds, with a blink and a sway."""
import math
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageFont

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "out"
AVENIR = "/System/Library/Fonts/Avenir Next.ttc"
W, H = 1920, 1080
FPS = 30
SECONDS = 2
HEAVY = ImageFont.truetype(AVENIR, 92, index=8)

BLUE = (32, 169, 255, 255)
FROG = (182, 230, 69, 255)
YELLOW = (255, 214, 74, 255)
PINK = (243, 68, 188, 255)
PURPLE = (163, 101, 237, 255)
INK = (21, 21, 36, 255)
WHITE = (255, 253, 240, 255)
TITLE = (244, 255, 248, 255)
FROG_LINE = (82, 114, 30, 255)


def lerp(a, b, t):
    return tuple(int(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


def backdrop():
    column = Image.new("RGB", (1, H))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(column)
    top, bottom = (8, 16, 14), (14, 32, 26)
    for y in range(H):
        draw.point((0, y), fill=lerp(top, bottom, y / (H - 1)))
    image = column.resize((W, H)).convert("RGBA")
    glow = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(glow).ellipse((360, 80, 1560, 860), fill=130)
    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(90))
    tint = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (36, 110, 86, 255))
    image.alpha_composite(Image.composite(tint, image, glow))
    return image


BACKDROP = backdrop()


def cubic(p0, p1, p2, p3, n=14):
    pts = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        t = i / n
        u = 1 - t
        pts.append((
            u**3 * p0[0] + 3 * u * u * t * p1[0] + 3 * u * t * t * p2[0] + t**3 * p3[0],
            u**3 * p0[1] + 3 * u * u * t * p1[1] + 3 * u * t * t * p2[1] + t**3 * p3[1],
        ))
    return pts


def quad(p0, p1, p2, n=8):
    pts = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        t = i / n
        u = 1 - t
        pts.append((
            u * u * p0[0] + 2 * u * t * p1[0] + t * t * p2[0],
            u * u * p0[1] + 2 * u * t * p1[1] + t * t * p2[1],
        ))
    return pts


def ellipse(draw, cx, cy, rx, ry, fill):
    draw.ellipse((cx - rx, cy - ry, cx + rx, cy + ry), fill=fill)


def blink_amount(t, center):
    """Close, hold, open. Returns 0 open .. 1 shut."""
    close, hold, open_ = 0.07, 0.05, 0.10
    start = center - close
    end = center + hold + open_
    if t < start or t > end:
        return 0.0
    if t < center:
        u = (t - start) / close
        return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
    if t < center + hold:
        return 1.0
    u = (t - center - hold) / open_
    u = u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
    return max(0.0, 1 - u)


class Figure:

        self.ground = ground
        self.scale = scale
        self.lift = lift
        self.sway = sway
        self.blink = blink

**Alerts**, all live and tied to a detection:

- **Workspace artifact missing** watches a missing target file.
- **Session restored after failure** watches a recovered session.
- **Dynamic tool invocation** watches a dynamic tool call.
- **Model latency over budget** watches a model call over 30 seconds.
- **Model spend over budget** watches a model call over one dollar.

**Reviews**, still drafts until someone launches them in Neatlogs:

- **Trace handling review** asks whether the span names the session, whether the prompt is absent, and whether the tool name is present.
- **Service recovery judge** scores recovery, paging, and whether the span is safe to keep.

Eight traces landed in the `trace-office` workflow: a working Cursor session, a missing-file failure and its recovery, a shared-project tool error, a Grok dynamic tool call, a Ledger session, a floor check, and a slow model call. ## cfo.ai

cfo.ai is where the price, the costs, and the runway belong. Cursor can reach it through the MCP server at `https://api.cfo.ai/mcp`, which is already listed in `.cursor/mcp.json`. The sheet in `evidence/cfo-business-plan.md` is the plan prepared for that workspace. It is not a signed-in export, and the in-app Business plan panel shows the same assumptions.

The struggle was treating $1,960 of revenue as a business. Forty teams at $49 a month produce that number. Neatlogs, hosting, and support then take it down to $1,210, and one founder still costs $4,000 a month. The base case does not cover the founder. Putting those facts in one cfo.ai-shaped sheet is what made the miss obvious: one seat price, Neatlogs left as the usage bill, and a second case of 120 teams that covers the founder with about $180 left. Nobody is hired until that growth case is real.

## Entire

Entire records the agent session behind a commit and keeps that session with the commit. This repository is already enabled, so a clone gets the same setup:

- `.entire/settings.json` stores checkpoints as git refs and syncs them to `origin`.
- `.cursor/hooks.json` calls the Entire CLI from Cursor. If the CLI is not installed, the hooks do nothing and the editor still works.

Install the CLI once:

```sh
brew install entireio/tap/entire
```

On Linux, `curl -fsSL https://entire.io/install.sh | bash`. Then work in Cursor as usual. A checkpoint is written when you commit, not before. The commit message gains a trailer, `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>`. On `git push`, those checkpoint refs go to origin with the branch. `npm run entire:status` shows whether this checkout is enabled.

Open a checkpoint on Entire. The commit SHA has to be the full one:

- [Typecheck fix](https://entire.io/gh/PatrickKish1/traceOffice/commit/34318789208ef384f85ea584035cc35003aab141) — `01M4RVJ3KDT91TGRVXDMNTN8DR`

cfo.ai is the sheet for the price, the costs, and what is left for a founder. Entire is the record of the agent session that produced a commit. Both are now in the README, and the GitHub description is set.

**The struggle.** Forty teams at $49 looked like a business because the revenue was $1,960. It was not. Neatlogs, hosting, and support take that down to $1,210, and a founder still costs $4,000 a month. Writing those same facts in the cfo.ai shape — one seat price, Neatlogs left as the usage bill, and a second case of 120 teams — is what made the miss obvious. One hundred twenty teams cover the founder with about $180 left. Nobody is hired on the base case. The MCP server is `https://api.cfo.ai/mcp`. The rows in `evidence/cfo-business-plan.md` are the plan prepared for that workspace. They are not a signed-in export.

**Entire is already in the clone.** `.entire/settings.json` stores a checkpoint on each commit. `.cursor/hooks.json` calls the Entire CLI from Cursor, and does nothing if the CLI is missing. Install it with `brew install entireio/tap/entire`, then `npm run entire:status`. The checkpoint id is the `Entire-Checkpoint` line on the commit. Push sends those refs to origin.

This commit’s checkpoint is [on Entire](https://entire.io/gh/PatrickKish1/traceOffice/commit/8b0f73e6b28ac285a24d937919a7df6144f71b48) as `01M4RXSFK8MB9T0CJPZM19NY4D`. The README also links the typecheck fix, the demo, and the Neatlogs reporting commit. The full commit SHA is required. A short SHA is rejected.
